info.name: Micro HRMS — Completed APIs
info.description: Maintained with each completed topic. Import the environment template and read postman/README.md. Session cookies, not bearer tokens. Select individual requests/folders intentionally: this is an API reference, not an all-at-once runner scenario. Writes modify the selected environment. Only implemented routes are included; leave/payroll/documents folders currently contain master settings only.

request.description: Public connectivity check; returns text. This is not a database readiness endpoint.

item.name: 01 — Authentication

request.description: Postman saves the session cookie automatically. Default email is microhrms@yopmail.com; supply your actual password locally. Logging in replaces the current session cookie for this host.
Use Company Admin/HR for management requests. Change tenant_email and tenant_password to test another user. Company is the slug, not the tenant UUID.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('current_user_id', data.user.id); pm.environment.set('tenant_id', data.user.tenantId); }

request.description: Use after employee activation. This replaces the admin session cookie. Log in as the company admin again before management requests.
Returns current account and permissions. It does not overwrite target user_id.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('current_user_id', data.user.id); }

request.description: Uses the most recently issued invitation token (company admin, standalone user or employee). Choose the intended account password, minimum 15 characters. Activation does not log in. For a new company admin, use this same password as tenant_password.

Changes the currently signed-in account password and revokes sessions. Required first for a platform account with a temporary password. Set current_password and new_password locally, then update the matching login password variable.
Signs out the active cookie session.
Revokes every session for the current account.

item.name: 07 — Users and roles

request.description: Run first to populate built-in role ID variables. Permission: roles.manage. Built-in roles are read-only; custom roles are company-specific.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); for (const role of data.roles) { if (['company_admin','hr','manager','employee'].includes(role.code)) pm.environment.set(role.code + '_role_id', role.id); } }

request.description: Replaces the complete role list. Add more same-company role IDs for multiple roles. Revokes existing sessions; self-change and last-admin removal are blocked.

item.name: 08 — Holiday calendar

request.description: Any active tenant account. Uses the linked employee location plus company-wide holidays; unlinked/unassigned users get company-wide dates only. Employees cannot supply a location or broaden scope. The year can be omitted to use the current company-timezone year.
Requires company.manage. Includes location lookup options, date-only holiday entries, company timezone/today and deduplicated annual/upcoming date counts.
Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.
Requires company.manage and a same-company location. Includes company-wide holidays plus this location. Archived locations can be reviewed for history.

item.description: Tenant permission: company.manage. The create request saves holiday_id. Updates use that ID; list requests never select an existing record for modification automatically.

Create/update requires company.manage. Company-wide dates cannot overlap any local holiday; different locations may share a date. Set location_id in the write body to a same-company active location for a local holiday. Existing legacy overlaps are displayed but count once. No deletion API or automatic public-holiday import is provided.

item.name: 09 — Attendance

request.description: Requires attendance.self and a linked employee. Omit month for the company-timezone current month. Returns recorded and explicitly marked projected days, schedule settings, summaries and today actions.
attendance.manage sees company employees; attendance.approve.team sees direct reports only. Use a returned id as employee_id. Supports search/page/limit.
HR, permitted direct-report manager, or employee self. No personal/bank data is returned.

Log in as an active/on-notice employee with attendance.self and an assigned or unambiguous applicable schedule. Server time determines the date and timestamp. One pair per date; never accepts employee_id or client timestamps.
Completes today’s open check-in. For a prior-day missed checkout, submit a correction. Hours/status use saved schedule rules.

Self-service only. Both timestamps require Z or an explicit UTC offset, must fall on work_date in the recorded company timezone, and cannot be future times. Saves regularization_id. One pending request per date.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('regularization_id', data.id); }

request.description: Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.
HR or direct-report manager. Excludes your own requests. Switch to another authorized reviewer account after submitting a request.
Applies once. Rejects self-review, stale attendance and locked payroll dates. Preserves original values and audits changes.
Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.
Requires attendance.manage. Replaces times and recalculates status. Saved schedule snapshots are retained. Existing pending requests become stale and must be rejected/resubmitted.
Allowed modes: absent, leave, holiday, weekly_off. Replaces times with null and worked minutes with zero. Leave here is an HR attendance marker; it does not alter leave balances.

item.description: Single daily pair; no overnight shifts, overtime or multiple breaks. Set employee work schedule before testing. Times and business dates use company timezone. Locked payroll dates cannot be changed. Run individual requests intentionally, with the appropriate self/manager/HR identity.
